name: ancplua-dotnet
description: C# refactoring, MSBuild, NuGet version management, Roslyn analyzers, runtime performance and layered releases for SDK-style .NET. Native MSTest work routes to mstest-extensions.

interface.longDescription: Agent workflows for C# refactoring, complete constant and dead-code reconciliation, MSBuild diagnosis, package and SDK version ownership, analyzers, runtime performance and layered NuGet releases. Correlate logs, metrics, traces, spans and profiles with production code and report evidence gaps. Supporting references and executable helpers load when needed. Native MSTest work routes to the mstest-extensions companion.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this .NET runtime performance problem using logs, metrics, traces, spans and profiles.
Audit this repository's build, package versions and analyzers.
Find every stale constant and dead check; reconcile indirect production uses and profile costs. Complete the inventory.

publication.release_notes: Route MSTest API questions and assertion corrections to their canonical skills in the unified marketplace.
